rows.en: Hit it, hit it!
That one's mine!
I'm gonna give 'em a taste of this!
I can do as well as Kaine, too!
I'll show you what I've got!
Once I decide to do it, I don't do it halfway!
I'm taking you down!
Hit, damn it!
Why, you...!!
Kaine! Stay back, Kaine!!
uncertain: Reason Tapp warns Kaine off is unclear (danger vs. Kaine on the other side); kept literal.

rows.en: There you are, Blue Hawk of Giganos!
So you finally showed up, you monster!!
So you're the big boss! Get ready!!
Here they come, the Giganos bunch!
Giganos! You've got some nerve showing up here!
I'm gonna knock that stuck-up nose of yours flat!
All right, let's go say hi to the little rich boy!
uncertain: The "rich boy" is presumably Meio.

rows.en: It's Gon Jem's pack of filth!
You little...!!
Payback time!!
Well then, time to show what the handsome lead can do!
Just go to sleep already!!
It's not too late to fix this! Come back, Kaine!!
Sorry, guys! I'm out!!
It's no good! I'm bailing out!!
Gwaaah! Somebody do something!
It punched through the D-2's armor?! You gotta be kidding!
G-go easy on me a little! ...What? You won't?
Dammit! If I go down here, my family's allowance...!!
uncertain: Tapp sends money home; "allowance" = the money he sends his family.

rows.en: Ngh! L-looks like I just barely made it out...!
It's no good! That thing's power is off the charts!!
How can this be happening?! Kaine!!
Dammit! I can't keep up with that thing!!
If it came down to raw power, I wouldn't lose...!!
Gah! They got my verniers! I can't move!
That bastard! What kind of power is that?!!
W-well, that's quite the lavish welcome...!
Guts first, guts second!!
Heh! Couldn't you come up with anything better?
Ugh! Well, this is a fine mess.
Gyaaah!! That lady plays real dirty...!
uncertain: The "lady" (ane-san) is presumably Min.

rows.en: Uh-oh...! Did I really piss off the Blue Hawk?!
Like size decides who wins or loses!
Ngh, whoa! So you're getting serious now, rich boy!!
I'm not scared, I'm not scared...!
Whoa there! Not bad!
You're not getting past me!
Whew! That's one tough hide!
Yeah, yeah! Thanks for your trouble, thanks!
Huh, mass-production models aren't half bad!
Stop it! Kaine!!
C'mon now... Is that all the Blue Hawk has got?
Those guys just never learn...
Yeow, that'd sting if it hit me...
Heh! Like that's gonna hit me!
With this, even the D-2 can do it!
Easy, easy!
And don't come back!
I'm lighter on my feet than I look!
Now that's what I call an iron wall!
Whoa!!
That stuff doesn't even make me flinch!
Heh heh, how do you like that?!!
Aw, wasting all that ammo...
Heh! Surprised? You won't push me around anymore!
Hey, hey, hey! I haven't wasted that much ammo, have I?!
It's tough being the handsome guy at times like this~
Where'd that guy run off to?!
Dammit! It slipped off somewhere I can't reach!
uncertain: Target unknown; used "it" (the enemy unit) to avoid assuming gender.

rows.en: Just leave it all to me!
I will now commence support, sir!
That many shots oughta bring it down!
Kaine! Don't charge in alone!
I'm going next, Kaine!
Light! Leave the rest to me!
Bad news! Get outta there!!
You're not getting through here!
Kaine! I can't stand to watch this!
Kaine! Get outta the way!!
Don't push it, Light! The D-3 can't take hits!
Light! You can't handle this one!!
You idiot! That's just what they want!
This is the moment! Let's get fired up!
Heh heh, leave it to meee!!
Aim real careful...
There!!
Dosukoooi!!
uncertain: Sumo heave-ho shout; kept as the romanized cry.

rows.en: Go get 'eeem!!
Roaaar!!
Don't move...!
C'mon, please hit...!
Charge complete! We're good to go!
Sonia, sweetie! Charge it up, quick!
With it this light, I can even use a sword!
Now's our chance!
uncertain: Shared Practice Squad set (Dan, Welner, Karl).

rows.en: If we make a name for ourselves, Captain Plato will be pleased too!
Launching a surprise attack!
You're mine!
You're in range! How shallow!
Don't underestimate us, the Practice Squad!
Kaine Wakaba! If only you weren't here!
A D-Weapon! Can you dodge with that huge body?!
At this range, your electronic warfare won't mean a thing!
If you attack, you'd better drop me in one hit!
The fight's only just beginning!
You were naive. Die!
We'll intercept!
Now it's our turn to attack!
C-Captaaain!
Damn you! We won't let you pass, no matter what!
Not yet... not yet...!
At this rate, I'll have failed the Captain!
You know nothing of our cause...! How dare you!
What they do can't even be called tactics!
You'd go this far to defy us?!
Even with amateurs at the controls, a D-Weapon is this strong?!
In long-range combat... we'd lose?!
What?! It's a support unit, but still a D-Weapon...!
It shouldn't affect flight...!
Ngh, don't get cocky!
Something like this won't finish me!
By the pride of the Practice Squad... I will not fall!
Ugh! Is this the power of the melee D-Weapon?!
This much damage from this range...?!
Are you saying they jammed us?!
Is that all you've got?!
No effect, no effect! Hahahaha!
Just a bluff!
Half-hearted attacks won't work on us, the Practice Squad!
What... it hit...?!
That won't even leave a scratch!
It hit?! Ngh... Kaine Wakaba!
If I avoid direct hits and close in...!
I got too careless, thinking it was just an EW unit.
Hmph, this is why amateurs are no good!
An EW unit shouldn't stick its nose in!
I told you it won't hit!
This is what they call a difference in skill!
What happened to your vaunted melee skills?!
And you call that an artillery unit? Don't make me laugh!
That had no effect!
Hahaha! What a waste of effort!
Damn! My ammo's running...!
From outside our effective range?!
Damn you!
As if I'd let that opening slip by!
Providing covering fire!
In front of the Practice Squad, no less!
Captain! I'll back you up!
Captain! Leave this to me!
We'll go with a combination!
We're launching a formation attack!
I won't let you!
Fall back! Leave this to the Practice Squad!
I can't let you go any further!
Close combat, eh? Interesting!
You'll be rust on my blade!
Heh... Fool!
Strolling right up to me, are you?!
Glory and victory to the United Empire Giganos!
I'll cut you down to my heart's content!
Treacherous scum!
Hehehehehe... You'd better start saying your prayers!
Damn you, Meio Plato! Defying me to the bitter end!
Those accursed D-Weapons!
I refuse to die!!
As long as I live, the Giganos Empire shall not fall...!
Stop! Don't do iiit!
I won't die! I refuse to die!!
I'm not dead yet!!
I won't forgive you, I won't!!
Curse you, getting in my way!
Don't think you can beat me with skills like that!
Oh-hooo! Not bad at all.
I cannot afford to be beaten by the likes of you!!
I am the Supreme Leader!
My United Empire is eternal!
Nngh! Don't joke with me!
Insolent wretch!
Shut your trap, small fry!!
Nnnrgh!
Oh ho, you actually hit me!
That won't work on this Gilgazamune!
That's exactly what I mean by naive!
You can't keep up with the Gilgazamune!
Persistent pest.
Hehehe hahaha... Fool!
Why can't I counterattack?!
I can't believe I'm unable to attack...!
uncertain: Also used by Mors (Imperial Guard captain); wording works for both.

rows.en: As a parting gift from this world, I'll fight you myself!
What happened to the Giganos spirit?!
I spare no effort when it comes to my amusement!
I, myself, will serve as your shield! Be honored!!
I'll send you all to hell together!
Drop dead!
I'll start with you as rust on my sword!
Anyone who defies me gets their head lopped off!
Go on, leave your ugly corpse out for all to see!
You think you can escape this Gilgazamune? Die!
I'll blow you all away at once!
Be blown to bits, you fools!
Commencing attack!
I won't let you escape!
Before they can ready their defenses... we strike!!
Wait there... I'll put you out of your misery!
Why not resign yourself to your fate with dignity?!
I hold no grudge against you small fry, but...!
I'm breaking through!!
It seems your luck has run out...!
You never learn... Fall!
Now, let's see how skilled you are... I'll test you!
Have you people no sense of dignity?!!
Move aside, Kaine Wakaba! I have no time to spare!!
You think you can stop me with a blade so full of doubt?!
Dorchenov!! Prepare yourself!!
Dorchenov!! Your crimes end here!!
The D-1! So it's Kaine Wakaba!
Kaine Wakaba! Fall in the name of the greater cause!
Our fated rivalry... I'll end it here!
The D-3... I'll catch it!
All of this is the Marshal's last will!
uncertain: Marshal = Guiltorre.

rows.en: Like master, like dog!!
Stop! What happened to your nation's pride?!
Curse the fate that put you in a machine like that.
So you've come, D-Weapon! I'll show no mercy!
Have you people no sense of dignity?!!
uncertain: Duplicate of q04508 (differs only by a comma in the Japanese); same English.

rows.en: Out of my way!
I'll praise you for a job well done... But this is the end!!
I'll snap those fangs of yours!
We, too, have something we must accomplish!
I have no time to waste on you! Out of my way!!
In place of the late Marshal, I will strike you down!!
I will strike you down, whatever it takes!
Heh, so this is as far as I go...
We'll settle this another time!
Not yet...! That's not enough to stop me!!
Ngh! I'd like to think that was just luck...!
Only by enduring pain will a great flower bloom...!
Nngh! To think you'd corner me like this!
You have convictions too, I'm sure! But I can't end here!
That lack of follow-through will surely be your downfall!!
Hmph...! That pilot has gotten better!
uncertain: Referent unnamed; used "that pilot" to avoid assuming gender.

rows.en: A man like you...! You disappoint me, Kaine Wakaba!!
Dorchenov! You, I will never forgive!
Ngh! Careless!
Tch, my mistake...!
A direct hit! On me?!
That's enough of your fooling around!
To think you can keep up with my machine... Impressive.
Not bad, for the likes of you...!
Ngh! You're good, Kaine Wakaba...!
Enough of your delusions, Kaine Wakaba!
Why can't you see your ideals are nothing but a fleeting dream?!
Ngh! Impossible...!
A clever move!
Oh? There are still those who dare face me...
Stop this pointless struggle!
You don't even know your own limits... Foolish.
I can only call this sheer ignorance...!
What's wrong, Kaine Wakaba? Surely that's not all you've got?
What do you think you're doing, Kaine Wakaba?!
Dorchenov! Enough of your pathetic struggling!!
So you've come!
Too slow! I've seen through your attack!
The likes of you can never catch the hawk...!
I have no time to bother with you!
Not with aim like that!
You won't hit me!
You dare pilot a Dragonar with that level of skill...?!
You can't keep up with my speed!
Heh... It seems just following me is all you can manage.
The Blue Hawk of Giganos... is no mere title!
Heh... You were one step short.
Don't think an attack like that will reach my life!
So that's all your convictions amount to!
You fell for it!
Don't think you can hold anything back against me...!
Haaaah!!
The schemer caught in his own scheme...
Heh... You got lucky.
To think you escaped me...!
Impressive. There's no way to target you like this...
That opening... will cost you your life!!
Adding insult to injury...! And a painful one at that!
uncertain: Idiom "a bee stinging a crying face"; second half refers to the sting being very painful.

rows.en: I won't give you time to heal your wounds!
I won't let your convictions go to waste...!
Fall back, Kaine Wakaba!
Well done... Leave the rest to me!
Don't throw your life away!
Fall back! I'll deal with that one!
Save that eagerness for later!
Don't put too much faith in the Dragonar, Kaine Wakaba!
I don't want to see you die in vain!
Fall back! This is beyond your skill!!
It turned into an all-out assault... But with this force, we can win...!
Now!! Active Pack Front!!
uncertain: Attack name not in glossary; romanized literally as "Active Pack Front". Needs a check on akurasu.

rows.en: Roger that!
Prepare yourself!!
The sword of judgment... Fall in the name of the greater cause!!
If you have no convictions, then sink here!!
Not fond of bullets? Then...!
Time to finish you!
Here I go!!
uncertain: Shared with Allenby; works for both.

rows.en: I'm gonna give you a whooole lot of loving!
uncertain: Sarcastic ("kawaigaru" = rough someone up).

rows.en: Got you!
Get ready!
Outta my way!
Now, why don't you just give up?!!
Heh... Found you, you little devil!
uncertain: Literally the "oni" (seeker) of tag/hide-and-seek; rendered as "little devil".

rows.en: I'm gonna stir things up!
Go down, you dragonfly!!
uncertain: "Katonbo" (glossary unit name) is used here as an insult meaning a flimsy dragonfly; translated as "dragonfly" rather than the unit name. Check.

rows.en: It just means I'm the only one who can take down a Dragonar!
Time for a little Dragonar hunt!
You're not getting away!
You especially are getting a whole lot of my loving!
Then how about this?!
Heh, that's what you get for mocking me!
Don't you move a muscle!!
Don't underestimate the Red Rose of the Desert!!
uncertain: Min's epithet; not in glossary, translated literally.

rows.en: We'll finish this another time!
Hah! ...What a joke...!
Tch, so that's it for today!
Next time, I won't let you off!!
Ngggh! How dare you do this to me!!
I'm gonna pay you back real good... You remember that!!
To think those guys would get me this bad...!!
I've come too far to back off now!
Heh, heh heh... You failed to finish me off!
Why you! Now you've made me mad!!
Not bad at all! Am I that scary to you?!
That sloppy finish is gonna be the death of you!!
Getting beat this bad by a kid... I've been played for a fool!!
Don't panic! It's only just started!
Not bad! I like that sort of thing!!
Ngggh! Move, damn it!!
I screwed up!
Wh-what the hell are you doing?!!
Hah! I'm not the type to give up easy!
Damn you, brat!!
Tch, Dragonar...! You're gonna pay for this!
Heh, you really think little of me!
You left a scratch on me!!
Tch, looks like I let my guard down!
You're gonna pay dearly for this!
Ooh, how brave...
Not even close! How cute...!
What the hell d'you think you're doing, you jerk?!!
So the famous D-Weapons aren't all that!
It's just kids' play after all!
Good, good! Ahaha!
My hunches are never wrong!
You're a hundred years too early to face me!
Where are you looking?!
Ahahaha... You've still got a long way to go.
I figured it'd be something like this!
I don't mind being chased, though.
Looks like your defeat is pretty much decided!
Ngh... Cheeky little trick!
You've gotta do at least that much!
Depending on how this goes, you won't get off easy!
You just don't know when to quit, do you?!
uncertain: Insult 野郎 targets the opponent; "you" avoids gendering.

rows.en: You oughta use your ammo more carefully!
uncertain: Reading: mocking an enemy who wasted shots (sits among out-of-ammo lines).

rows.en: You'll never win with that wimpy stance!
Out of ammo...!
Tch, should've loaded more.
Just one step away!!
All right, let's wrap this up!
You trying to grab all the glory?!
Whoa there! Don't you move!!
A wounded dog! Here I go!!
Let me have a go at them too!
Let me have a turn too, Colonel!
uncertain: Colonel = Gon Jem, presumably.

rows.en: No way I'm babysitting the gorilla!
uncertain: "Gorilla" is presumably Gon Jem (or another brutish ally).

rows.en: I'll back you up! Captain!
uncertain: Captain unidentified (possibly Meio).

rows.en: Good, good! I love young ones! They try so hard!
Allies are supposed to help each other out!
What're you having so much trouble with?!
I'll be your shadow!
This isn't your turn!
See? I told you so!
That's reckless, Colonel!
Butt out! You lantern-headed gorilla!!
uncertain: "Chouchin gorilla" literally "lantern gorilla"; exact nuance and target (likely Gon Jem) unclear.

rows.en: Whoa! I won't let you get the Captain!
You should listen to big sis once in a while.
You toy soldier! Don't act tough!
If you're like this already, I worry for later!
Got it? I'm the commander here! Go!!
Now... steel your nerves!! Here we go!!
You think you can get away?! Come on, let's finish 'em!!
I'll support you! Don't screw up!
And don't you screw up either!
You got it!!
My edge is extra sharp today!
My chainsaw cuts real good!!
Just rest in peace already!
Get in my way and you'll get hurt!!
Wanna see my killing technique?!
I'm gonna play a little rough! Get ready!!
Boys! Here's a present from big sis!
Come on, boys! Here's your hot milk!!
uncertain: "Hot milk" seems to be Min's mocking name for her attack; kept literally.

rows.en: You're coming with me!!
